description_en: Queries a custom alert monitoring rule
description_zh: 获取自定义监控告警规则
name: GetAlertRule

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled

Notification.description_en: The configuration for the alert notification

items.description_en:
The alert notification channel. Valid values:

Mail

Phone

Sms: text message

Dingding: DingTalk

Feishu: Lark

Weixin: WeCom

Webhook: custom webhook
items.description_zh:
告警通道，枚举值：
Mail: 邮件
Phone: 电话
Sms: 短信
Dingding: 钉钉webhook
Feishu: 飞书webhook
Weixin: 企业微信webhook
Webhook: 自定义Webhook

IntervalInMinutes.description_en: The interval at which an alert notification is sent. Unit: minutes. Valid values: [5,10000]
IntervalInMinutes.description_zh: 告警间隔，单位为分钟，取值范围[5,10000]

Maximum.description_en: The maximum number of times an alert notification can be sent within a calendar day. Valid values: [1, 10000]
Maximum.description_zh: 一个自然日内的告警最大次数，取值范围[1, 10000]

Extension.description_en: The additional configuration of the alert recipient. If the ReceiverType parameter is set to DingdingUrl, you can set this parameter to {"atAll":true} to remind all members in a DingTalk group
Extension.description_zh: 告警对象需要的额外配置，当 ReceiverType 为 DingdingUrl，支持设置 {"atAll":true}  @所有人

ReceiverType.description_en:
The type of the alert recipient. Valid valves:

AliUid: Alibaba Cloud account ID.

Shift Schedules: the personnel in a shift schedule.

TaskOwner: the task owner. The task owner can receive custom alerts and event alerts.

Owner: the baseline owner. The baseline owner can receive baseline alerts.

WebhookUrl: URL of a custom webhook.

DingdingUrl: DingTalk webhook URL.

FeishuUrl: Lark webhook URL.

WeixinUrl: WeCom webhook URL
ReceiverType.description_zh:
告警接收对象类型，枚举值：
AliUid: 阿里云UID
ShiftSchedule: 值班表
TaskOwner: 任务责任人，适用于自定义告警和事件告警
Owner: 责任人，适用于基线告警
WebhookUrl: 自定义webhookUrl
DingdingUrl: 钉钉webhookUrl
FeishuUrl: 飞书webhookUrl
WeixinUrl: 企业微信webhookUrl

items.description_en: The ID of the alert recipient. If the ReceiverType parameter is set to AliUid, set this parameter to an Alibaba Cloud account ID. If the ReceiverType parameter is set to ShiftSchedule, set this parameter to a shift schedule ID. If the ReceiverType parameter is set to WebhookUrl, DingdingUrl, FeishuUrl, or WeixinUrl, set this parameter to a corresponding URL
items.description_zh: 告警接收对象值。当 ReceiverType 为 AliUid 时填阿里云UID，为 ShiftSchedule 时填值班表ID，为 WebhookUrl / DingdingUrl / FeishuUrl / WeixinUrl 时填入对应的 URL

SilenceEndTime.description_en: The end time for silence. The time is in the HH:mm:ss format
SilenceEndTime.description_zh: 静默结束时间，格式为 HH:mm:ss

SilenceStartTime.description_en: The start time for silence. The time is in the HH:mm:ss format
SilenceStartTime.description_zh: 静默开始时间，格式为 HH:mm:ss

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the owner of the rule
Owner.description_zh: 自定义规则的责任人阿里云UID

Extension.description_en: The extended information about the rule. This parameter is required for specific types of alerts
Extension.description_zh: 扩展信息，部分触发条件需要配置

CycleUnfinished.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the CycleUnfinished type

CycleAndTime.description_en: The configurations of the scheduling cycle and timeout period of the instance

CycleId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling cycle of the instance. Valid values: [1,288]

Time.description_en: The latest completion time of the instance within the scheduling cycle. The time is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
Time.description_zh: 超时时间，格式为 hh:mm，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

Error.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the Error type

AutoRerunAlertEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether an alert is triggered if a batch synchronization task is automatically rerun upon a failure
AutoRerunAlertEnabled.description_zh: 离线任务由于失败自动重跑，是否产生告警

StreamTaskIds.description_en: The IDs of the real-time computing tasks. This parameter is required when you monitor real-time computing tasks
StreamTaskIds.description_zh: 监控实时计算任务时，填入对应的任务ID

items.description_en: The ID of the real-time computing task

InstanceErrorCount.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the InstanceErrorCount type
InstanceErrorCount.description_zh: 实例出错数量告警配置

Count.description_en: The maximum number of instances on which an error occurs. Valid values: [1,10000]
Count.description_zh: 出错的实例数，取值范围为[1,10000]

InstanceErrorPercentage.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the InstanceErrorPercentage type
InstanceErrorPercentage.description_zh: 实例出错比例告警配置

Percentage.description_en: The maximum percentage of instances on which an error occurs in the workspace to the total number of instances. Valid values: [1-100]
Percentage.description_zh: 出错实例占比，取值范围 [1-100]

InstanceTransferFluctuate.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the InstanceTransferFluctuate type
InstanceTransferFluctuate.description_zh: 转实例数量波动告警配置

Percentage.description_en: The maximum percentage of fluctuation in the number of auto triggered node instances that are generated in your workspace. Valid values: [1-100]
Percentage.description_zh: 转实例波动百分比，取值范围[1-100]

Trend.description_en:
The way in which the number of auto triggered node instances that are generated in your workspace fluctuates. Valid values:

abs: the absolute value. The number of instances increases or decreases.

increase: The number of instances increases.

decrease: The number of instances decreases
Trend.description_zh:
转实例波动类型，枚举值：
abs: 绝对值
increase: 增长
decrease: 下降

Timeout.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the Timeout type

TimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The timeout period. Unit: minutes. Valid values: [1, 21600]

UnFinished.description_en: The configuration for an alert of the UnFinished type

UnFinishedTime.description_en: The latest completion time of the instance. The period is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
UnFinishedTime.description_zh: 未完成时间，格式为 hh:mm，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

AllowTasks.description_en: The nodes that are not to be monitored

items.description_en: The ID of the node that is not to be monitored
The ID of the monitored object

Type.description_en:
The type of the monitored objects. Valid values:

Task: node

Baseline: baseline

project: workspace

BizProcess: workflow
Type.description_zh:
监控对象类型，枚举值：
Task: 任务节点
Baseline: 基线
Project: 工作空间
BizProcess - 业务流程

Type.description_en:
The alert type. Valid values:

Finished: An instance is successfully run.

UnFinished: An instance does not finish running before a specified point in time.

Error: An error occurs on an instance.

CycleUnfinished: An instance does not finish running as expected within a specific cycle.

Timeout: An instance times out.

InstanceTransferComplete: An instance is generated by the auto triggered node.

InstanceTransferFluctuate: The number of generated instances fluctuates.

ExhaustedError: An error persists after an instance is automatically rerun.

InstanceKeyword: An instance with errors contains specified keywords.

InstanceErrorCount: The number of instances on which an error occurs reaches a specified threshold.

InstanceErrorPercentage: The proportion of instances on which an error occurs in the workspace to the total number of instances reaches a specified threshold.

ResourceGroupPercentage: The usage rate of the resource group reaches a specified threshold.

ResourceGroupWaitCount: The number of instances that are waiting for resources in the resource group reaches a specified threshold
Type.description_zh:
触发报警的类型，枚举值：
Finished: 实例完成
UnFinished: 实例未完成
Error: 实例出错
CycleUnfinished: 实例周期未完成
Timeout: 实例超时
InstanceTransferComplete: 任务转实例完成
InstanceTransferFluctuate: 实例数量波动
ExhaustedError: 自动重跑后仍出错
InstanceKeyword: 出错实例包含关键词
InstanceErrorCount: 出错实例数量
InstanceErrorPercentage: 出错实例占比 
ResourceGroupPercentage: 资源组利用率
ResourceGroupWaitCount: 资源组等资源实例数

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的 ID，用于定位日志、排查问题
